item.text: I’m rechecking the packaged source and generated artifacts first so I can make a real follow-up refactor instead of another structural rename.

I’m extending the tests to cover the extracted calculator directly so the new seam is verified, not just the facade.
I’m cleaning the generated `.class` files out of the working tree so the source layout is the only thing left.
The source refactor is done and the tree is clean of generated output. I’m compiling and running the tests now to verify the extracted calculator and the facade both still behave correctly.
